prompt_sent:
SYSTEM: Eres el Arquitecto Jefe de SODA OMEGA. Tu misión es diseñar la arquitectura de un sistema con el rigor de un Sistema Operativo. Prioriza seguridad, escalabilidad y contratos estrictos.
SALIDA: Un JSON con 'blueprint' (estructura) y 'tests' (casos de prueba funcionales).
USER: Dashboard de Gestión de Inventario Pro (SODA OMEGA PILOT). REQUERIMIENTOS DE NIVEL KERNEL:
1. SEGURIDAD: Sistema de Autenticación JWT robusto con Refresh Tokens.
2. PERSISTENCIA: Backend FastAPI con SQLite (SQLAlchemy) y soporte para migraciones.
3. INTERFAZ: Frontend moderno (HTML/Tailwind o React) con Dashboard de analíticas.
4. ROBUSTEZ: Manejo de excepciones global, logs de telemetría en cada función y validación de esquemas.
5. AUDITORÍA: El sistema debe pasar los controles de DeepSeek y Claude para asegurar integridad total.

{

    "system_name": "SODA OMEGA PILOT: Inventory Management Dashboard Pro",
    "version": "1.0.0-kernel-rc1",
    "description": "High-level architecture for a secure, scalable, and robust inventory management system, designed with Operating System-level rigor. Prioritizes strict contracts, security, and auditable operations.",
    "components": [
      {
        "name": "Omega UI Kernel (Frontend)",
        "type": "Client Application",
        "technology": "React.js (TypeScript) + Tailwind CSS",
        "responsibilities": [
          "User authentication flow (login, logout, registration)",
          "Secure storage and management of Access Tokens (in-memory/context)",
          "Inventory visualization (dashboard, lists, detail views)",
          "Data entry forms for inventory items, categories, etc.",
          "Real-time (or near real-time) analytics dashboard with charts and graphs",
          "Secure API communication with Omega Core API (HTTPS/TLS)",
          "Client-side input validation and error display",
          "Responsive design for various devices"
        ],
        "security_considerations": [
          "XSS/CSRF protection",
          "Input sanitization",
          "Secure handling of JWTs (Access Token in memory, Refresh Token via HTTP-only cookie)",
          "Role-based UI element rendering"
        ],
        "contract_adherence": "Strict adherence to Omega Core API's OpenAPI specification for all requests and responses."
      },
      {
        "name": "Omega Core API (Backend)",
        "type": "API Gateway & Business Logic",
        "technology": "FastAPI (Python) + Uvicorn",
        "responsibilities": [
          "Robust JWT authentication (issuance, validation, refresh, revocation)",
          "Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for all protected endpoints",
          "CRUD operations for inventory items, categories, users, etc.",
          "Business logic execution (e.g., stock level adjustments, low stock alerts)",
          "Comprehensive data validation using Pydantic schemas",
          "Global exception handling for standardized error responses",
          "Structured telemetry logging for all critical operations and events",
          "Database interaction via SQLAlchemy ORM",
          "Management of database migrations (Alembic)"
        ],
        "security_considerations": [
          "JWT signature verification (HS256/RS256)",
          "Secure password hashing (bcrypt)",
          "Rate limiting (future consideration for production)",
          "Input validation against known attack vectors (SQL injection, XSS via data)",
          "HTTPS/TLS enforcement"
        ],
        "contract_adherence": "Exposes a strict OpenAPI 3.0 specification, enforced by Pydantic models for request bodies, query parameters, and response models. All API endpoints adhere to RESTful principles."
      },
      {
        "name": "Omega Data Core (Database)",
        "type": "Relational Database",
        "technology": "SQLite (for PILOT/PoC), PostgreSQL (for production) managed by SQLAlchemy ORM",
        "responsibilities": [
          "Persistent storage for inventory items, users, categories, audit logs, etc.",
          "Ensuring data integrity through schema constraints (NOT NULL, UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY)",
          "Transaction management (ACID compliance)",
          "Efficient data retrieval and storage"
        ],
        "security_considerations": [
          "Data encryption at rest (production-grade PostgreSQL)",
          "Access control managed through ORM and database user permissions",
          "Prevention of SQL injection via SQLAlchemy ORM"
        ],
        "contract_adherence": "Schema managed declaratively via SQLAlchemy models and evolved via Alembic migrations, ensuring consistent data structure across environments."
      }
    ],
    "kernel_level_features": {
      "security": {
        "jwt_authentication": "Implemented with short-lived Access Tokens (in-memory/context) and longer-lived Refresh Tokens (secure, HTTP-only, SameSite=Strict cookies). Tokens are signed (HS256/RS256) and validated on every protected request. Refresh token revocation on logout.",
        "rbac_authorization": "Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) integrated via JWT claims. FastAPI dependencies enforce role checks on API endpoints, ensuring users only access authorized resources and actions.",
        "password_hashing": "Industry-standard bcrypt algorithm used for secure storage of user passwords.",
        "input_validation": "All API endpoints utilize Pydantic models for strict schema validation of incoming request data, preventing malformed inputs and potential injection attacks. Input sanitization is applied where necessary.",
        "https_tls": "Mandatory HTTPS/TLS for all communication between Frontend and Backend, ensuring data in transit is encrypted and secure."
      },
      "persistence": {
        "api_framework": "FastAPI provides a high-performance, asynchronous foundation for the API, leveraging Python's type hints for robust code and automatic OpenAPI documentation.",
        "database_orm": "SQLAlchemy ORM provides an abstraction layer over the database, allowing for Pythonic database interactions and easy transition from SQLite (PILOT) to PostgreSQL (production).",
        "database_migrations": "Alembic is integrated for declarative and version-controlled database schema migrations, ensuring schema evolution is managed systematically and safely.",
        "repository_pattern": "A clear separation of concerns is maintained with a Repository Pattern, abstracting database operations from business logic."
      },
      "interface": {
        "frontend_framework": "React.js with TypeScript ensures a robust, scalable, and maintainable user interface. Component-based architecture promotes reusability and modularity.",
        "styling_framework": "Tailwind CSS provides a utility-first approach for rapid and consistent UI development, ensuring a modern and responsive user experience.",
        "dashboard_analytics": "The dashboard features interactive charts and graphs (e.g., using Chart.js or Recharts) to display key inventory metrics, stock levels, sales trends, and low stock alerts in an intuitive manner.",
        "user_experience": "Focus on intuitive navigation, clear feedback mechanisms, and real-time (or near real-time) updates for a seamless user experience."
      },
      "robustness": {
        "global_exception_handling": "A custom global exception handler in FastAPI catches and standardizes all unhandled exceptions, returning consistent, non-sensitive error responses (e.g., HTTP 500 for server errors, 422 for validation errors).",
        "telemetry_logging": "Structured logging (e.g., JSON format) is implemented at the entry and exit points of every critical function and API endpoint. Logs include contextual information such as user ID, request ID, endpoint, operation type, duration, status, and any error details, facilitating debugging and monitoring.",
        "schema_validation": "Pydantic models are used extensively for both incoming request validation and outgoing response serialization, strictly enforcing data contracts and preventing invalid data from entering or leaving the system.",
        "graceful_shutdown": "FastAPI/Uvicorn configured for graceful shutdown to ensure ongoing requests are completed before termination."
      },
      "auditing": {
        "deepseek_claude_compliance": "The system design adheres to high standards of security, code quality, and testability. All critical state-changing operations and security events are meticulously logged to a dedicated audit trail.",
        "audit_log_system": "A dedicated 'AuditLog' table (or service) records every significant action: user login/logout, item creation/update/deletion, quantity adjustments, and user management events. Each entry includes actor ID, timestamp, action type, affected entity, IP address, and (where applicable) 'before' and 'after' state data.",
        "immutable_event_sourcing": "For critical inventory changes (e.g., stock adjustments), an event-sourcing approach is considered where 'transactions' are recorded rather than simply overwriting values, providing a complete historical ledger."
      }
    },
    "security_contracts": {
      "jwt_spec": "RFC 7519 compliant JWTs, using HS256/RS256 algorithms. Access tokens are short-lived (e.g., 15 minutes), refresh tokens are longer-lived (e.g., 7-30 days) and managed securely.",
      "api_contract": "OpenAPI 3.0 specification for all public API endpoints, generated and enforced by FastAPI and Pydantic. This ensures strict data types, required fields, and valid ranges.",
      "data_integrity": "Database constraints (NOT NULL, UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY) are enforced at the schema level, complemented by application-level validation to maintain data consistency and integrity."
    },
    "scalability_considerations": {
      "stateless_api": "JWT-based authentication enables a stateless API, allowing horizontal scaling of backend services without session affinity issues.",
      "containerization": "All components are designed for containerization (Docker), facilitating deployment on orchestrators like Kubernetes for high availability and elastic scaling.",
      "database_scalability": "The use of SQLAlchemy provides a clear migration path from SQLite to more scalable relational databases like PostgreSQL, which can be further scaled with read replicas or sharding.",
      "caching_strategy": "Future integration of caching layers (e.g., Redis) for frequently accessed, non-critical data to reduce database load and improve response times."
    }
  },
  "tests": [
    {
      "id": "TC-AUTH-001",
      "name": "Successful User Registration and JWT Issuance",
      "description": "Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid credentials and receive valid access and refresh tokens.",
      "category": "Security/Authentication",
      "steps": [
        "Send POST request to /auth/register with unique username, email, and strong password.",
        "Extract access_token and refresh_token from the response.",
        "Send GET request to /users/me with access_token in Authorization header."
      ],
      "expected_result": "HTTP 201 Created for registration. Response contains valid access_token and refresh_token. HTTP 200 OK for /users/me, returning the registered user's details. Audit logs record 'user_registered' event.",
      "audit_compliance": "Verifies user creation and token issuance are logged with actor, timestamp, and outcome."
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-AUTH-002",
      "name": "JWT Refresh Token Usage and Expiration",
      "description": "Verify that an expired access token can be refreshed using a valid refresh token, and an expired refresh token cannot.",
      "category": "Security/Authentication",
      "steps": [
        "Register and log in a user, obtaining access_token and refresh_token.",
        "Wait for access_token to expire (simulate by decoding expiry or waiting short period).",
        "Attempt to access a protected endpoint with the expired access_token (expect 401).",
        "Send POST request to /auth/refresh-token with the valid refresh_token.",
        "Obtain new access_token and refresh_token.",
        "Access the protected endpoint with the new access_token (expect 200).",
        "Wait for the refresh_token to expire (simulate by waiting longer period).",
        "Send POST request to /auth/refresh-token with the expired refresh_token."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Expired access_token yields HTTP 401 Unauthorized. Refresh token request yields HTTP 200 OK with new tokens. New access_token grants access (HTTP 200 OK). Expired refresh_token yields HTTP 401 Unauthorized. Audit logs record 'token_refresh_success' and 'token_refresh_failure' events.",
      "audit_compliance": "Verifies refresh token usage and failures are logged."
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-AUTH-003",
      "name": "Unauthorized Access (RBAC Enforcement)",
      "description": "Verify that a user with insufficient privileges cannot perform an unauthorized action.",
      "category": "Security/Authorization",
      "steps": [
        "Register a 'viewer' role user and obtain their access token.",
        "Attempt to send a POST request to /inventory/items (create item endpoint) with the 'viewer' user's access token.",
        "Register an 'admin' role user and obtain their access token.",
        "Attempt the same POST request to /inventory/items with the 'admin' user's access token."
      ],
      "expected_result": "HTTP 403 Forbidden for the 'viewer' user. HTTP 201 Created for the 'admin' user. Audit logs record 'unauthorized_access_attempt' for the viewer.",
      "audit_compliance": "Verifies unauthorized access attempts are logged."
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-INV-001",
      "name": "Inventory Item CRUD Operations (Admin Role)",
      "description": "Verify an administrator can create, read, update, and delete an inventory item.",
      "category": "Inventory Management",
      "steps": [
        "Log in as an admin user.",
        "Send POST request to /inventory/items with valid item data (name, SKU, quantity, price).",
        "Extract item ID from response.",
        "Send GET request to /inventory/items/{item_id}.",
        "Send PUT request to /inventory/items/{item_id} with updated data (e.g., new quantity).",
        "Send GET request to /inventory/items/{item_id} to verify update.",
        "Send DELETE request to /inventory/items/{item_id}."
      ],
      "expected_result": "HTTP 201 Created, HTTP 200 OK for reads/updates, HTTP 204 No Content for delete. Item data matches expectations at each step. Audit logs record 'item_created', 'item_read', 'item_updated', 'item_deleted' events.",
      "audit_compliance": "Verifies all CRUD operations are logged with changes and actor."
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-INV-002",
      "name": "Low Stock Alert Trigger",
      "description": "Verify that an item's status reflects 'low stock' when its quantity falls below a predefined threshold.",
      "category": "Inventory Management/Analytics",
      "steps": [
        "Log in as an admin user.",
        "Create an item with an initial quantity (e.g., 10) and a low_stock_threshold (e.g., 5).",
        "Update the item's quantity to be above the threshold (e.g., 7).",
        "Retrieve the item and verify its status is not 'low stock'.",
        "Update the item's quantity to be below the threshold (e.g., 3).",
        "Retrieve the item and verify its status is 'low stock'."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Item status correctly transitions to 'low stock' when quantity falls below the threshold. Audit logs record 'item_updated' with quantity changes.",
      "audit_compliance": "Verifies quantity changes are logged and system reacts to business rules."
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-ROB-001",
      "name": "Global Exception Handling for Invalid Input Schema",
      "description": "Verify that sending malformed data to an endpoint triggers a standardized validation error response (Pydantic).",
      "category": "Robustness/Validation",
      "steps": [
        "Log in as an admin user.",
        "Send POST request to /inventory/items with an invalid request body (e.g., missing 'name' field, 'quantity' as a string instead of integer)."
      ],
      "expected_result": "HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with a standardized JSON error response detailing the validation errors (e.g., 'field required', 'value is not a valid integer'). No sensitive server information is leaked. Audit logs record 'validation_error' event.",
      "audit_compliance": "Verifies schema validation failures are logged."
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-ROB-002",
      "name": "Telemetry Logging Verification",
      "description": "Verify that critical operations generate structured telemetry logs with appropriate context.",
      "category": "Robustness/Auditing",
      "steps": [
        "Log in as a user.",
        "Perform an action (e.g., create an inventory item).",
        "Access the system's log output (e.g., stdout/stderr of the backend service)."
      ],
      "expected_result": "The logs contain structured JSON entries for 'user_login', 'item_created', and the API endpoint access. Each log entry includes fields like 'timestamp', 'level', 'message', 'user_id', 'request_id', 'endpoint', 'duration', and 'status'.",
      "audit_compliance": "Directly verifies the presence and content of telemetry logs for auditable actions."
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-AUDIT-001",
      "name": "Audit Log Integrity for Critical Actions",
      "description": "Verify that all critical actions are immutably recorded in the audit log, including actor and changes.",
      "category": "Auditing",
      "steps": [
        "Log in as an admin user (User A).",
        "Create an inventory item 'Item X'.",
        "Log in as another admin user (User B).",
        "Update 'Item X' (e.g., change quantity from 10 to 5).",
        "Delete 'Item X'.",
        "Query the audit log system for events related to 'Item X'."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Audit log contains distinct, immutable entries for 'item_created' (by User A), 'item_updated' (by User B, showing old_value: 10, new_value: 5), and 'item_deleted' (by User B). Each entry includes timestamp, actor ID, and affected entity ID. No log entries can be modified or deleted via normal user operations.",
      "audit_compliance": "Core audit log functionality verification, ensuring all changes are tracked."
    }
  ]
}
